name: noesis
description: Listen to any document. Free, private, on-device text to speech.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for (const d of ['wasm','cmaps','standard_fonts','iccs']) fs.cpSync('node_modules/pdfjs-dist/'+d,'public/pdfjs/'+d,{recursive:true});fs.mkdirSync('public/dict',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/dictionary-en/index.aff','public/dict/en.aff');fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/dictionary-en/index.dic','public/dict/en.dic');fs.mkdirSync('public/ort',{recursive:true});for (const f of ['ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs','ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm']) fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/onnxruntime-web/dist/'+f,'public/ort/'+f)"
